component.name: HybridBench
component.summary: Linux Electronics Engineering & Mobile Device Servicing Platform

description.p: HybridBench is a professional Linux desktop application that unifies electronics engineering, board-level diagnostics, embedded systems development, and mobile device servicing into a single integrated platform.

ul.li: Hardware Abstraction Layer (USB, UART, SPI, I2C, JTAG, SWD, CAN)
Mobile Device Service Workspace (Android, iOS, Qualcomm, MediaTek)
Schematic Overlay System with component recognition
Power Analysis with boot signature matching
Electronics workspace with oscilloscope, logic analyzer, multimeter views
Mobile service workspace with ADB/Fastboot integration
AI assistant for diagnostics and repair guidance
HAL supporting USB, UART, SPI, I2C, JTAG, SWD, CAN
